metadata.name: Testimonial Coverflow
metadata.description: A 3D coverflow carousel built for quotes: drag and release with momentum, or use arrows, dots, Home and End. Each card has layered parallax between the quote mark, text and avatar, blur by distance, and a stretching dot indicator.
